compatibility_principle: later consumers MUST interpret package under its declared version and negotiated required profiles; stricter optional semantics never silently alter older packages

policies.contract: required:true yields effective minimum max(declared_min,1); required:false does not relax positive min; explicit max below effective min invalid only when profile is required
policies.deferred: whether a default satisfies required remains undecided and MUST NOT be assumed

policies.contract: integer safe range, textual arbitrary-precision decimal normalization, calendar date, UTC whole-second datetime, HTTP(S)-only limited URI normalization
policies.deferred: unsupported URI schemes, date fractions and other formats are not generally canonicalized; not_supported outside declared profile

policies.contract: exact typed {kind,id} pair membership; multiple inherited parent restrictions intersect; no implicit subtype expansion; unknown or unsupported typed contracts fail closed
policies.deferred: normative subtype expansion and behavioral junction rules require a new negotiated profile

release_gates: explicit package/profile versions and fail-closed negotiation
end-to-end positive, negative and unknown-profile package vectors in Python and TypeScript
conformance scope and unsupported behaviors published before GO
